title: A1 Swaara v1.0.1 - Playback Crash Fix & Security Hardening
changelog:
- Fixed full app crash when tapping or transitioning to any track by dispatching ExoPlayer queue state reads onto Main thread in SwaaraPrecacheEngine
- Removed exposed Firebase Push Notifications & public Broadcast sender UI from Settings -> Accounts & Sync
- Removed client-side broadcast write helper to harden notification security
- Includes all v1.0 Obsidian Glass UI unification, Lossless Audio Engine, and Shake-to-Report improvements
